title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: SBD MR > Cass >DAT > CD + AUD patch from low-gen cassette

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with uneven audio quality, but a superb acoustic "Know Your Rider" and strong second‑half jams make this 1970 Fillmore West show a must‑listen.
ai_review.review: The performance shines thanks to an especially spiritual acoustic rendition of "Know Your Rider" and memorable moments like Black Peter, New Speedway, Pigpen, Hard to Handle and Man's World. While the soundboard tape fluctuates between good and poor sections—particularly early on—the latter half sounds great, allowing the music’s magic to come through.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the musical performance (standout acoustic Rider and several jams) and give mostly 4‑star ratings, while noting variable but generally acceptable soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio bounces from good to bad; early sections have patches and drop‑outs, but the latter part is clear and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early acoustic set is highlighted; the second half picks up steam with strong jams, though recording issues slightly dampen the experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice comes through clearly on Black Peter, giving listeners a sweet kiss from the past.
